scope: Independent whole selected batch factual web review; reviewed unlanded vocabulary and directed graph proposal only. No curated boards, targets, partitions, recipes, difficulty, application or landing approved.
review_method: Fresh exact-headword DEX JSON and attributed ordinary flexion pages for all56 selected items, Romanian second sources for every item, actual stable bundle endpoint senses/owners, and primary examples for conditional feature claims. Local source caching supports this same one review round; earlier mechanical checks did not use web or supply semantic verdicts.

process_deviations.rationale: The serialized direct-fetch pass used >=2.15seconds between starts, but I also opened Pagaie and Corabie together in one web-tool call while that pass was running. Those two extra opens were not coordinated to the spacing requirement. I disclosed the mistake to root immediately, made no further Dex opens outside the paced helper, completed only this review round, and released the dictionary slot to quality after the last paced retry completed. No claim that every review request was paced is made.
process_deviations.author_research_pacing: Not reassessed or rewritten; this deviation belongs to the independent review only.

verification.secondary_failures_handled: Failed direct TLS/403/timeout sources were checked through web-tool readable/indexed primary text where relied upon; unobserved generic page bodies are not accepted as evidence.
verification.same_category_main_batch_graph_floors: All45 new nodes satisfy aggregate4–8distinct,>=2main,>=2same-category,<=2batch after incoming/deduplicated edges.
verification.source_correction_scope: Six item-level source corrections; five edge source bindings. No node sense, ordinary form, caption, endpoint or threshold change requested.
verification.pdf_limitations: Municipal204-page scanned PDF first2physical pages visually inspected only. Relevant printed17/55 and33/55 passages independently retrieved through web index; no physical-page equivalence claimed. Readable PS4 article independently confirms metal structure.
verification.game_quality_scope: A1/A2/A3/A4 plus relevant A7, C5 and D2 conceptual checks only; whole-board B/C/D/E gates remain for later authoring.
